externalServiceEnvironment: No native-source or QuestDB live-test opt-in variables were set for this run.
scope: Full local Java test suite and isolated Batch distribution packaging after adding bounded GDP quarter-range collection, exact quarter-continuity gating, SQLite quarterly evidence watermarks, /v1/coverage/quarterly, quarter-end dry-run planning capped at min(2000, source maxRows), quarterly Prometheus gauge, and read-only reconciliation query for unresolved writes, orphan Batch executions and external children. Separate real Tushare/SQLite/isolated QuestDB acceptance covers 138 consecutive cn_gdp quarters (1992Q1–2026Q2); a wider 1953Q1–2026Q2 probe was rejected as sparse before any QuestDB write. Existing 127-month CPI/PPI/PMI/M2 acceptances remain recorded. This does not close full history parity, remaining source assets, derivations, queued backfill or all JDB-01–15 acceptance. A fixed-argv/no-shell external child protocol was added with bounded environment/output, durable reservation before launch, PID-start identity, structured progress, bounded child-scoped evidence validation, and timeout diagnostics that do not kill or replace a live child. It compiled and all 384 tests passed (66 environment skips); Java-only executor fixture tests now cover VERIFIED/PARTIAL, wrong date, definition-version drift, stale artifact, progress log capture, and non-killing/non-duplicating timeout behavior. Actual research-runner integration, full launch/process-tree fault matrix, and the broader JDB-01—15 gaps remain outstanding. The newly registered `share_float` source was verified from real Tushare for 45 rows (announcement date 2018-12-20, one security), and `fina_audit` for one row (2018-04-28, one security); each was read back VERIFIED from isolated QuestDB with one send. Python parity and full history/market coverage remain open. This rerun registers bounded `fut_daily` single-contract collection, legacy `update_time` projection and fixture/schema coverage; this is not a real Tushare or QuestDB acceptance for that source. Added `fut_settle` with the legacy typed schema and generated update_time; its live Tushare 2026-09-28 / IF2610.CFX acceptance and the corresponding fut_daily acceptance each returned one row and read back VERIFIED from isolated QuestDB with one send. These bounded samples do not establish full-market or historical parity. Added `fut_mapping` for one continuous contract/date with month-contract and date validation; the real Tushare 2026-09-28 `IF.CFX` sample returned one row and read back VERIFIED from isolated QuestDB with one send. Full history and Python parity remain unverified. Added `ft_limit` with a single futures contract/date scope and legacy metadata projection; the real Tushare 2026-09-28 `IF2610.CFX` sample returned one row and read back VERIFIED from isolated QuestDB with one send. Full-market and Python baseline parity remain unverified. Added `ft_limit` with a single futures contract/date scope and legacy metadata projection; the real Tushare 2026-09-28 `IF2610.CFX` sample returned one row and read back VERIFIED from isolated QuestDB with one send. Four bounded futures sources are packaged; full-market coverage and Python baseline parity remain unverified.
